scope: Offline prepared CC0 electronic drums; no PWA/Android/Surge XT integration or release

tests.independentReview: Converter byte rebuild, fractional durations, seed zero, two rates, varied blocks, bad selectors/flags, 24 pattern combinations, 130-second max pattern, true CLI replay; A/B stereo issue fixed and rechecked.

abPreview.a: Original SOU1 procedural voices/master, common events; no startup fade
abPreview.b: FSA prepared samples, same common events

limitations: No listening approval or claim that numeric checks establish perceived musical quality.
Single sample per articulation, no velocity layers/round robins; not certified hardware recordings.
Existing EventScore generates only kick/snare/closed hat from new bank. Toms/cymbal/marimba remain VCSL.
Symmetric hat choke with same-frame order dependence. Full voice pool fails rather than silently stealing.
No full Virtuosity library, native instrument host, app deployment or browser device verification in this change.
GitHub CI status must be checked separately on saved commit.
